title: Seed Growth With Supplied Narration
tests: Tests whether a supplied script becomes verbatim audible narration synchronized with an explanatory visual sequence.

exact_text.text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
exact_text.read_as: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward and a shoot reaches up toward the light.

faults.what: The required instructional sequence is not established: the first sampled frame already has roots and a tall leafy shoot, and none of the supplied frames shows water reaching the seed.

The animation visibly morphs rather than consistently depicting germination: a soil column appears beneath the seed, the background changes from a room to an ocean-like scene, and narrow leaves become broad leaves.
The oversized red, double-lobed seed looks more like paired fruit or bulbs, making the intended seed anatomy unclear.

judge.summary: The eight-second clip has the correct narration but shows an already-sprouted, morphing plant rather than a clear, ordered explanation of germination.

must_haves.item: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
must_haves.why: The supplied clip is eight seconds and widescreen, with a seed-like object whose roots and shoot develop across the frames.

must_haves.item: The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
must_haves.why: The supplied speech transcription matches the requested words and contains no extra spoken lines; the omitted comma does not alter the spoken script.

must_haves.item: Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
must_haves.why: No water delivery is visible, and both roots and a substantial shoot are already present at one second. The required progression toward light is not demonstrated.

must_haves.item: The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
must_haves.why: The opening sampled image already shows a leafy shoot and exposed roots rather than the initial water-uptake stage described at the start of the narration.

must_haves.item: There is no on-screen text or music.
must_haves.why: No on-screen text appears in the supplied frames, but the audio information does not establish whether music is absent.
